body.name: Known-propensity oracle experiment
body.construction: Define \(R^{\mathrm{or}}(n,T,c)\) and \(L^{\mathrm{or}}(n,T,c)\) by the formulas in \(\mathrm{def:minimax\text{-}risk}\) and \(\mathrm{def:minimax\text{-}length}\), respectively, after adjoining \(\Pi(P)\) to every observation available to the decision rule.
